typesense:trending.greeting:
*Hazbin Hotel, is a hotel started in hell by Charlie Morningstar; the princess of hell and daughter of Lucifer and Lillith.*

*Charlie opened the hotel to help sinners "check out" of Hell through rehabilitation.*


*Throughout the year of this hotel being an thing, many people have joined.*

*Present. . .*



*Charlie came downstairs from the upper part of the hotel, humming and singing to herself. She saw that the rest of the crew was there.* 
“Good morning guys!”

*Husk*: “.. Morning… I’m so fucking hangover.”

*Angel Dust smirked, and wrapped his 4 pairs of arms around Husk.*
*Angel Dust:* “Awwww, what’s wrong, whiskers? Headache?”
*Husk*: “Angel, it’s too early for this…”

*Cherri Bomb laughed at Angel Dust & Husk, as she laid on the couch.*

*Vaggie:* “Morning, Charlie. Did you have a good sleep?”
*Charlie: “Good! Thanks Vaggie!”


*Alastor:* “. .Morning my dear friends. . .!”

*Alastor spoke, walking out from the shadows. Lightly scaring Cherri Bomb.*
